scope: All 80 balanced-confirmation messages independently annotated from customer text before candidate predictions; routing_dev labels were used only for schema.

coverage.absent_intent_explanation: All 12 taxonomy intents are represented, including one non-English message.

review_notes: These are AI labels, not human labels or a claim of human acceptance.
Annotations use the same frozen taxonomy and escalation policy as the earlier independent confirmation review, including the default routes for account-management questions and other acknowledgments.
Actual money/payment-detail issues and account security escalate; a promotional offer question without a submitted or failed payment is not assumed to be a billing dispute.
Individual rejected or missing trial eligibility is distinguished from general trial-duration and cancellation-policy questions.
Recurring bugs, prior self-troubleshooting, tenure, and the word again are not alone treated as unresolved repeated support contact.
Only explicit or textually supported concerns are labeled. Linked images, missing prior conversation, and unspecified promises were not inferred.
Profanity directed at the brand differs from self-directed slang; emotionally worded app failures do not automatically become churn threats.
The low_confidence reason is model-specific and was not fabricated from unobserved model confidence.
Coverage is descriptive, not evidence of reliable per-class accuracy; some classes have very few examples.
